Robert Half is looking for a Marketing Coordinator (m/v/x) for a company in Brussels-Zellik.

Our client is an international and innovative organization active in a technical B2B environment. The company combines a strong global presence with a hands-on local approach and is currently looking for a versatile marketing professional to support its activities in the French market.

Your responsibilities

• You create, schedule, and manage social media content across platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
• You write and edit engaging marketing content for email campaigns and digital communication channels.
• You coordinate the development of French-language case studies and customer testimonial content.
• You pre-qualify incoming leads and contact prospects with relevant discovery questions before transferring them to the sales team.
• You support the organization of trade fairs, customer events, demonstrations, and other commercial initiatives in the French region.
• You translate marketing materials from English into French, including brochures, flyers, and technical documentation.
• You help manage CRM activities, including email sequences, templates, and user support for the sales team.
• You provide administrative support linked to sales and marketing activities.

You recognize yourself in the following

• You hold a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
• You have at least 1 year of experience in marketing or sales support; internships may also be considered.
• You have a strong interest in a B2B and ideally technical or industrial environment.
• You are a native French speaker, and you are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• You are experienced with social media platforms in a professional context.
• You work comfortably with Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
• Knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM system is a strong asset.
• You have excellent writing skills and a very strong command of French spelling and grammar.
• You are eager to learn, well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• You can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with local and international teams.

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is continuing to build and strengthen its own organization. To support our customers and sales activities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France, we are looking for a Sales Business Supporter.
 

These are newly created positions that offer the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. During your onboarding, you will work closely with colleagues from both Wygwam and our parent company to gain a thorough understanding of our customers, systems, and processes. Once this foundation is established, you will play an important role in improving the way we work and helping to build a future-proof support organization.
 

As a Sales Business Supporter, you will be a key link between customers and internal departments such as Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. You will support the complete customer journey, combining customer service, commercial support, process coordination, and administrative follow-up. Your contribution will help ensure excellent customer experience while supporting efficient business operations.
 

In this role, you will work in an international environment with colleagues from several European countries. You will report to a manager based in Denmark and collaborate with stakeholders throughout the organization. If you enjoy taking ownership, working across different functions, and contributing to a business undergoing transformation, this could be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Support end-to-end customer and sales processes across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France. 

• Handle daily customer inquiries and provide professional follow-up through the appropriate communication channels. 

• Process customer orders accurately and ensure timely administrative follow-up. 

• Manage customer returns and coordinate with relevant internal departments to ensure efficient resolution. 

• Maintain customer, product, and pricing information in SAP and ensure data accuracy at all times. 

• Manage commercial agreements, pricing structures, and bonus schemes in accordance with company guidelines. 

• Monitor delivery performance and support the resolution of delivery-related issues when required. 

• Act as the primary link between customers and internal stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. 

• Support product launches, pricing updates, and future SAP-related developments. 

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the implementation of more efficient ways of working. 

• Work accurately with data across multiple systems while maintaining a high standard of quality and consistency. 

• Ensure customers receive a professional, timely, and positive experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across departments and countries to achieve shared objectives. 

• Participate actively in meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities throughout the organization.  

 

 

• You have experience in Sales Support, Customer Service, Operations, Business Support, or a similar commercial role. 

• You are fluent in Dutch and French, both spoken and written. 

• You have a professional level of English and can communicate confidently in an international environment. 

• You enjoy taking ownership and consistently follow tasks through to completion. 

• You are comfortable working in a changing environment where priorities may shift. 

• You have a structured and organized way of working with strong attention to detail. 

• You have a customer-focused mindset and enjoy building positive relationships with customers and colleagues. 

• You are proactive and solution-oriented, always looking for opportunities to improve processes. 

• You are resilient and motivated by the challenge of helping build new ways of working while learning from existing processes. 

• You have a good understanding of business processes and administrative workflows. 

• You are confident working with data and managing information across multiple systems. 

• You have strong Excel skills and are comfortable working with the wider Microsoft Office suite. 

• Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is considered a strong advantage. 

• You enjoy collaborating across different functions and working with diverse teams.

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is dedicated to delivering innovative and intelligent electrical solutions for modern buildings. We work closely with architects, consultants, and installers, to integrate technology seamlessly into architectural concepts and functional environments. Both Niko Home Control as our lighting control portfolio belong to your responsibility.

For this role, we are looking for two electricians or hands on specialists who are ready to take the next step in their career and move into a more project-based and commercially oriented pre-sales role. Your electrical experience and interest in building technology will help you understand customer needs, interpret technical information and translate it into accurate project proposals and quotations.
 

The pre-sales technicians we are looking for are responsible for preparing project proposals and quotations for customers, based on information gathered from tenders, customer requests and input from sales colleagues. You’ll work across the relevant product groups within the Wygwam portfolio and play a key role in ensuring customers receive accurate, clear and timely project support.
 

In this role, you’ll handle project-related customer inquiries through different channels, mainly by phone and email. You’ll make sure every request is followed professionally, within the agreed deadlines, and with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and customer satisfaction. To achieve this, you’ll work closely with colleagues in sales, technical teams and other internal departments.
 
 

• Create project proposals for customers based on tenders, customer input and information gathered from sales colleagues. 

• Prepare quotations based on approved project proposals, as well as direct requests from wholesalers, customers or colleagues. 

• Handle customer inquiries related to project support through relevant channels, mainly by phone and email. 

• Maintain project mailboxes and ensure every customer receives a reply within 24 hours. 

• Follow up customer requests within the agreed deadline and take action when another solution is needed. 

• Register all relevant data in the CRM system. 

• Save and organize all relevant project documentation according to the agreed structure. 

• Ensure that every project proposal follows the department guidelines and contains all required information. 

• Keep your calendar up to date with planned project proposals and other relevant tasks to support smooth collaboration with colleagues. 

• Carry out all assignments with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and clear documentation. 

• Work in a structured and systematic way, aiming for error-free results while continuously improving processes and output. 

• Ensure customers have a positive and professional experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 
 

• You have a strong interest or knowledge in building automation and the standards, protocols and technology used. 

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time without losing overview. 

• You have strong communication skills and can translate technical information into clear explanations for both customers and colleagues. 

• You have a team-oriented mindset and enjoy working closely with sales and technical teams. 

• ·You are customer-focused and proactive in understanding customer needs and providing technically sound solutions. 

• You work accurately and have a strong sense of responsibility for the quality of your work. 

• You are comfortable using standard office software such as Outlook, Excel and Word. 

• You are familiar with digital tools related to daily administrative and project follow-up tasks. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written. 

• You have basic to intermediate knowledge of English, sufficient to understand internal communication and participate in meetings. 

• Fluency in French, both spoken and written, is considered a strong plus.

Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

This company moves over 250 orders a day from  730 suppliers in EAME to over 72 facilities all over the world.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a bachelor’s degree? Are you an analytical thinker with strong communication skills? Can you express yourself clearly, both orally and in writing, in English and Dutch? If so, you could be the Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we’re looking for!

Within the Global Parts Supply (GPS) team, working with suppliers is key. As a GPS team member, you are the vital link between suppliers and customers, managing all supplier communications. The mission is to maintain a healthy supply chain and prevent shortages that could lead to customer back orders. On a daily basis, you liaise with suppliers, drive accountability for their results, and work toward challenging but achievable goals that ensure superior service levels.

As a Logistics Planning Analyst, you are responsible to establish solid business relationships with a set of defined suppliers: 

• Focus on timely and quality deliveries to the distribution center, ensuring parts are available for the end customer.
• Educate and hold suppliers accountable to achieve challenging business results.
• Value teamwork and collaborate with key partners such as transportation, procurement, and engineering as needed.
• To be successful, you will need to develop and master a thorough understanding of our supply chain processes and systems.
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Monitor schedules to ensure punctual and efficient shipments with suppliers.
• Track supplier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
• Maintain strong communication and positive relationships with both internal divisions and external suppliers.
• Evaluate and challenge supplier results based on the supplier performance standard.
• Analyze and correct data irregularities.
• Provide thorough support on high priority back orders.

The Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we are looking for has the following skills:

• Minimum Master’s degree with a strong link to Supply Chain, Logistics Management, Production, and Logistics or Transport.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Analytical mindset.
• Fluent written and oral skills in English and Dutch are required, French or German is a plus.
• Motivated to work in a target focused area.
• Self-motivated and committed.
• Strong interpersonal skills.

Robert Half is collaborating with a leading global player in the high‑tech manufacturing industry to recruit a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x).

Our client, an international organization active in advanced industrial technology, develops innovative solutions used in sectors such as energy‑efficient glass, consumer electronics, solar applications and industrial machinery. With production sites in the US, Europe and Asia, the company employs appr. 300 FTE's and operates in a fast‑growing, technology‑driven market.

Position

As a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x), you provide high‑quality financial insights to support strategic decisions across the group. You work closely with leadership teams in different regions and functions, contributing to stronger cost control, profitability analysis and data-driven planning.

This is a key function for an experienced finance professional who enjoys combining analytical depth with a strong business partnering mindset.

From out your role you will interact with the Group Controller and CFO.

Your responsibilities include:

• Managing and improving cost accounting across multiple sites, ensuring accurate standard costing and analyzing manufacturing structures.
• Providing insight into margins and product profitability, including variance analysis and margin reviews.
• Delivering monthly performance analyses across business units: actuals, budget, forecast, prior‑year comparisons.
• Highlighting trends, risks and opportunities, providing clear insights for management.
• Conducting analyses on pricing, capacity, product mix and working capital to support strategic decision-making.
• Developing dashboards, KPIs and Power BI reports to harmonize reporting across sites.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting and long‑range planning, ensuring inputs align with strategic assumptions.
• Contributing to improvement projects such as M&A analyses, transfer pricing, sourcing optimization and cost accounting enhancements.
 

Your profile

• A bachelor's or master's degree in finance.
• At least 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, controlling or a similar finance function, ideally in an international manufacturing or engineering environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
• Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems and experience building dashboards in Power BI (must).
• The ability to balance operational detail with a strategic helicopter view.
• Excellent planning and organizational skills, especially in a fast‑moving context.
• A plus: experience with consolidation systems or IFRS.
• We are looking for an English proficient professional. Dutch is not required.
• Willingness to travel internationally maximum 2 weeks each quarter.

Your first step into support. A hands-on opportunity to build real-worldnetworking expertise, even if you’re at the beginning of your career.

Our partner is a fast-growing technology company operating in theconnectivity and managed network servicesspace. As their activities continue to expand, they are looking for aSupport Engineerto join their technical team. 

 

This is more than a traditional support role: it’s a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset who wants todevelop a career in networking, gain practical experience with different technologies, and progressively specialize in areas such asVPN, WAN, routing and SD-WAN.
Support Engineer - Your day to day
• Provide1st & 2nd line technical supportto customers via phone and ticketing systems.
• Configure and preparenetwork equipment and routersfor new deployments.
• Monitor network environments and proactively identify and resolveconnectivity issues.
• Manageequipment inventoryand ensure accurate tracking of technical assets.
• Participate in anon-call rotationto support customers and maintain high service availability.
• Supporton-site installationsfor new deployments across different environments and locations.
Support Engineer - More about you
• Some practical knowledge ofnetworking fundamentals, such as VLANs, VPNs, WAN/LAN, IP routing or basic firewall configuration.
• You may bejunior or at the start of your career— motivation and technical curiosity are more important than extensive experience.
• A strong interest inNetworking & Connectivity, with the ambition to develop deeper expertise in technologies such as SD-WAN and SDN.
• Acustomer-oriented mindsetand a genuine commitment to delivering a high-quality support experience.
• Strong communication skills inDutch and English; a good level of French is a plus.
• A proactive, hands-on personality with a genuineappetite for learning and solving technical challenges.

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department.
 
Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector.
 
As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings.
 
You will alternate between batch production and custom work.
 
In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders.
 
You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks.
 
Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller

• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments

• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness

• You are fluent in English

• Willing to work in a two-shift system

• Team player with a positive attitude

Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of iconic brands and an established presence in the Belgian retail market.

Jobomschrijving

• Take full ownership of the commercial portfolio.
• Develop and maintain strong strategic customer relationships and act as the key commercial point of contact.
• Lead customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans, contracts and commercial agreements.
• Drive sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and developing customer-specific initiatives.
• Support the Channel Manager in defining sales strategies, commercial targets and promotional policies.
• Develop sales volume budgets and forecasts for assigned customers.
• Monitor customer spending, contractual agreements and commercial investments against budget

• Strong knowledge of the Belgian retail/FMCG market.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, business planning and claim management.
• Autonomous and comfortable taking full ownership of customer relationships.
• Strong presentation and communication skills.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is required.
• Fluent in French and English.

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
